components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
            The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid email address; the stored value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Serialized as an ISO date
            'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner. When present it is used
            to derive the owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
            Serialized as an ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the city's region: NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. When supplied it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address (they share a household). A
            request-only flag; it is not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, or UNKNOWN
                when the postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name. Assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode. Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is
                created with sharesHousehold true; every owner in that household
                carries the same value. Null when the owner is not part of a
                shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name
                (case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level: a number from 1 to 3 assigned at
                creation. Starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present,
                gains a further 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount
                is 0), and is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION component of the owner's region-and-hash identity: the
                customerCode prefix, i.e. the region derived from the postcode
                (2000-2099->NSW, 3000-3099->VIC, 4000-4099->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode is absent or in no known range. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate computed against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' when 65 or over. Null when birthDate is absent.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value that all duplicate detection is expressed
                through, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) +
                '|' + (householdId or empty). A new owner is rejected with 409 only
                when its whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because the
                telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have distinct keys. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created on the same effective business day;
                otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean

    Specialty:
      title: Specialty

        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
            The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid email address; the stored value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Serialized as an ISO date
            'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner. When present it is used
            to derive the owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
            Serialized as an ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the city's region: NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. When supplied it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and address (they share a household). A
            request-only flag; it is not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, or UNKNOWN
                when the postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name. Assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode. Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who belong to the same
                household (same last name and postcode). Deterministic: the first 12
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name,
                a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner with the same last
                name and postcode computes the same value automatically. Null when
                the owner has no postcode (and so belongs to no household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name
                (case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level: a number from 1 to 3 assigned at
                creation. Starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present,
                gains a further 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount
                is 0), and is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION component of the owner's region-and-hash identity: the
                customerCode prefix, i.e. the region derived from the postcode
                (2000-2099->NSW, 3000-3099->VIC, 4000-4099->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode is absent or in no known range. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate computed against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' when 65 or over. Null when birthDate is absent.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived value that all duplicate detection is expressed
                through, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) +
                '|' + (householdId or empty). A new owner is rejected with 409 only
                when its whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because the
                telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have distinct keys. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created on the same effective business day;
                otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's last name and postcode while
                having a different telephone; otherwise false. Assigned at creation

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible

                null when it is not a possible duplicate. Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

                The single derived value that all duplicate detection is expressed
                through, formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) +
                '|' + (householdId or empty). A new owner is rejected with 409 only
                when its whole identity key equals an existing owner's; because the
                telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household with
                different telephones have distinct keys. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
tool_use_result.newString:
description: >-
                A composite derived value formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' +
                (email or empty) + '|' + (householdId or empty), where householdId is
                derived from the last name and postcode. Duplicate detection itself is
                keyed on the household: a new owner is rejected with 409 when it shares
                an existing owner's household (same last name and postcode) unless it
                sets sharesHousehold. Derived from the owner's own fields.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
            The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid email address; the stored value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Serialized as an ISO date
            'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner. When present it is used
            to derive the owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
            Serialized as an ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the city's region: NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. When supplied it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and postcode (they share a household): it bypasses
            the household-duplicate block and declares the owner a household member, so
            it is also not flagged as a possible duplicate. The householdId is always
            derived from the last name and postcode regardless of this flag. A
            request-only flag; it is not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, or UNKNOWN
                when the postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone

## What I changed

The change makes `householdId` a deterministic function of `(lastName, postcode)` and re-keys the household rules on it.

**`Households.java`** — now the single source of truth for the household key:
- `householdId(rawLastName, postcode)` returns the first 12 upper-case hex chars of `SHA-256(normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode)`, or `null` when there's no postcode (no household). Dropped the old address-based derivation, `normalizeAddress`, and `matches`.

**`AssignHousehold.java`** — simplified to just stamp `owner.setHouseholdId(Households.householdId(lastName, postcode))` on **every** owner. No longer conditional on `sharesHousehold`, and no more back-filling existing members (unnecessary now that the id is a pure function of the key).

**`EnsureUniqueIdentity.java`** — the duplicate block is now household-based: if the new owner shares a computed `householdId` with an existing owner, it's a 409. `sharesHousehold` returns early (bypasses the block, declaring a household member). Owners with no postcode can't collide.

**`FlagPossibleDuplicate.java`** — now takes the request DTO and short-circuits to `possibleDuplicate = false` when `sharesHousehold` is set, so a declared member is never a suspected duplicate.

**`DuplicateIdentityException.java`, `Owner.java` (javadoc), `openapi.yml`** — updated descriptions for `householdId`, `sharesHousehold`, `identityKey`, and the exception to reflect the new `(lastName, postcode)` household semantics.

This satisfies the spec's observable contract, verified by `coreSameLastNameAndPostcodeShareHouseholdId`: same lastName+postcode → same `householdId` (second owner needs `sharesHousehold` to bypass the 409), different lastName → different `householdId`.

One note: the spec mentions "the household-size input to the membership level." This codebase's `membershipLevel` is derived from email presence and `namesakeCount` (same first+last name), with no household-size term — the OpenAPI schema documents it that way too. Since no household-size input exists here, there was nothing to re-key; I deliberately did not invent one, as that would contradict the documented membership formula. I left that rule untouched.
